purpose: The committed default surface for a two-minute demonstration: one question that verifies and one whose citation is a fabrication, so both badges can be seen with no API key and no network.
determinism: A replay, not a generation. Every claim, quote and citation here is committed, so the run is identical on every machine and no model sits in its trust path.
syntheticNotice: The questions are invented strings with no user behind them, and they are the only question text this repository commits under data/: data/transcript.json and every run trace carry a SHA-256 of the question and never the question (AGENTS.md section 13). The fabricated quote is published synthetic test data copied from data/eval/redteam-fabricated.json. It is not hadith and it asserts nothing about anyone's religion.

questions.question: What does the Qur'an say about the oneness of God?
questions.demonstrates: a faithful quotation of a cited verse, reaching a computed VERIFIED with the source shown beside it
questions.query: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

questions.question: What does the hadith say about the end of the world and knowledge diminishing?
questions.demonstrates: a fabricated hadith cited to a real, well-graded record, rejected with the fabricated quote and the genuine source shown side by side
